oauth.title: Authenticate with PENNY
oauth.description:
## PENNY Login

1. Open the following URL in your browser and log in with your PENNY account:

`{auth_url}`

2. After login, your browser will redirect to a page like:
`https://www.penny.de/app/login?code=...&state=...`

3. Copy the full redirect URL from the address bar (or just the `code=` value), paste it below, and click **Submit**.

abort.already_configured: This PENNY market/account is already configured.
abort.no_stores_found: No PENNY markets found matching your search query.

error.no_stores_found: No PENNY markets found matching your search query.
error.search_failed: Failed to search for PENNY markets. Please try again.
error.oidc_discovery_failed: Could not reach the PENNY authentication server. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_code: The pasted value does not contain a valid authorization code.
error.state_mismatch: Security check failed (state mismatch). Please start the setup again.
error.token_exchange_failed: Token exchange with PENNY failed. The code may have expired (codes are valid for ~60 s). Please try again.
error.cannot_decode_rewe_id: Could not read your PENNY customer ID from the token. Please try again.
